label: 3. Linux: Generar Release (.deb y .tar.gz)
command: cmake --preset linux-release && cmake --build build-release && cd build-release && cpack

label: 4. Windows: Configurar CMake
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build-win -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmake --preset windows-debug; if (Test-Path build-win\build.ninja) { (Get-Content build-win\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win\build.ninja }

label: 5. Windows: Compilar y Ejecutar
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; Stop-Process -Name FronterMind -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path build-win\build.ninja) { (Get-Content build-win\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win\build.ninja }; ninja -C build-win; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $env:PATH = "C:\Qt\6.12.0\msvc2022_64\bin;$PWD\build-win;$env:PATH"; .\build-win\FronterMind.exe }

label: 6. Windows: Generar Release (.zip e Instalador .exe)
command: $vsPath = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module "$vsPath\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsPath -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments "-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64"; Stop-Process -Name FronterMind -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmake --preset windows-release; if (Test-Path build-win-release\build.ninja) { (Get-Content build-win-release\build.ninja) -replace 'build build\.ninja: RERUN_CMAKE', 'build build.ninja.disabled: RERUN_CMAKE' | Set-Content build-win-release\build.ninja }; ninja -C build-win-release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist-win -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist-win | Out-Null; Copy-Item .\build-win-release\FronterMind.exe dist-win\; Copy-Item .\build-win-release\*.dll dist-win\ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; C:\Qt\6.12.0\msvc2022_64\bin\windeployqt.exe --release --qmldir src/ui/qml dist-win\FronterMind.exe; Compress-Archive -Path dist-win\* -DestinationPath FronterMind-v0.1.0-Windows-x64.zip -Force; if (Test-Path "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe") { & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe" installer.iss } }
